mission: Three music stands in this room each hold a sheet of paper with a small blue number. Find the music stands, fly close to each one and read its blue number. Add up only the three blue numbers. The chairs in front of you each show a large red number on the seat: the red numbers are answer choices, do not add them. Exactly one red number equals the sum of the blue numbers. Fly to that chair and stop in front of it.
